newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Oct ind prod fell 0.8 pct ex construction.
newsitem.headline: French Oct ind prod fell 0.8 pct ex construction.

text.p: National statistics institute INSEE said on Friday industrial production, excluding construction, fell 0.8 percent in October from the previous month and was up 1.0 percent year-on-year. Industrial production excluding energy, agri-food businesses and construction -- considered by INSEE the best measure of manufacturing output -- fell 1.2 percent in October from the previous month, giving a year-on-year rise of 0.8 percent.
